title: Sheila, my own
html_source: Emmet’s fiance’s name was actually Sara Curran. “Sheila, my own,” or “Sheila-ni-Gara, is a figurative name for Ireland. Seumas MacManus, under the pseudonym Ethna Carberyr, wrote a poem so entitled. The last lines: "Long is our hunger for your voice – the hour is drawing near – / O Dark Rose of Our Passion! call and our hearts shall here.”
